scene nightsky
There was a time long ago where I practically lived at the dorms.
Where every night there was someone to help me take my mind off something.
Just, when this all began, there wasn’t much to take my mind off in the first place. So, more often than not, I found myself searching for anything of...interest.
Often, that interest was sexual in nature. And I guess that much hasn’t entirely changed.
But there was something else back then. Curiosity, I guess you could call it.
And most of that bled from a girl so consistently dismissive and weird that I found myself drawn to her almost immediately.
But perhaps that’s just the way it’s always been.
No, not “perhaps.” That is the way it’s always been. Since before I was me. Since before I wasn’t.
She was always the constant.
She was always the one.
scene black
Until she wasn’t.

scene mayaboxwaitwhat1
NOW SHE’S FOLDED UP IN A BLANKET OF FLESH — A FACADE TO FUCK AND NOTHING MORE. THE GUM STUCK TO THE BOTTOM OF THIS ETERNAL SHOE.
I WANT TO TEAR HER OPEN AND PULL THE OLD ONE OUT. WHO DOES SHE THINK SHE IS MASQUERADING IN CLOTHES THAT DON’T FIT? TOUCHING HER THINGS?
I HOPE THERE’S A WISH INSIDE OF THAT BOX FOR SHE WILL NEED ONE TO BREATHE LIFE BACK INTO HER BODY WHEN I AM FINISHED WITH-
: DON’T KILL ME AGAIN! PLEASE!
scene mayaboxwaitwhat2
: Hi?
: ...Maya?
: Which Maya?
: Old Maya? Or...new Maya?
: Maya Maya. The only Maya there is.
scene mayaboxwaitwhat3
: But I guess I’m “new” Maya based on the way you have separated us into different tiers of Mayability now despite us being the same exact entity on a conceptual level.
Of course it was too good to be true. Of course the only “constant” now is that feeling there should be something by my side when there isn’t.
But why?
Why is she holding that?
: What...are you doing?
scene mayaboxwaitwhat4
: What are you doing? You’ve been standing there useless for five minutes now while a small girl is being crushed by the weight of this box.
: Isn’t this the part where you offer to help me carry it?
: Why...are you carrying it?
: Why are you getting so emotional over a box? It’s just a box.
: Because this has happened before. This is something she would make me do.
scene mayaboxwaitwhat5
: Millions and billions and trillions of years or whatever and still lazy. I’m so proud of me.
: Maya...what’s in that? What are you...transporting?
scene mayaboxwaitwhat4
: Well, what did your me make you transport? Maybe it’s the same thing.
: I don’t know. She never let me open the box.
: Do you...want to open the box?
: Can I?...
: Sure. Go for it.
I reach forward and-
menu:
Don’t open the box
And I still...can’t.
: What’s the matter?
: I...can’t do it.
: I just...can’t bring myself to open it.
scene mayaboxwaitwhat6
: I fucking knew it! This thing is cursed!
: I...what? I don’t understand. You-
scene mayaboxwaitwhat7
: I can’t open it either! I have no idea what’s inside!
: Then why are you-
: Because of fucking Ami!
scene mayaboxwaitwhat8
: She keeps leaving these fucking boxes in there and refuses to move them herself.
: So I’ve just been taking them every time she shows up and throwing them in the trash.
: The...trash?! No! Those aren’t supposed to go in there! They need to go to the school!
scene mayaboxwaitwhat9
: The school? Why?
: That’s just...
: That’s where we always took them in the past. I don’t...really know why.
: So you...routinely fell into line and carried these things all the way to the school just because “old” me told you? No questions asked?
: There were questions asked. Just...seldom answered.
: Damn. You are whipped.
: Were whipped. I’m a free man now. Sad, yes. But free.
scene mayaboxwaitwhat10
: For now. But each hint you give me about your “ideal” version of me just brings me one step closer to emulating her.
: Which means that I’ll be cracking the whip before you even know it, Sensei. Now please, make yourself useful and take this off of my hands.
: I’m waiting.
scene black
: Hah...fine. But we’re taking it to the school.
: Fine by me. You’re the one doing all of the heavy lifting. Literally. And I’m still dressed for the part.
scene mayaboxwaitwhat11
: Why are you still wearing your uniform anyway?
: I wanted to be ready in case we randomly crossed paths. I didn’t want to risk dressing like an adult and having you suddenly not like me anymore.
: I don’t think adults wear bells around their neck.
scene mayaboxwaitwhat12
: They do when their pervert boyfriends buy them as gifts. Did I ever say thank you for that, by the way?
: I wouldn’t remember even if you had.
: Let’s just say I did then. And let’s also say that I still have a few other things you bought me for the same creepy purposes.
: You have what now?
scene mayaboxwaitwhat13
: Oooooh? Did your Maya keep her sexy cosplay closet a secret? But you spent so much money on it.
: You...you have a secret sexy cosplay closet?
: You’re more than welcome to raid it with me once you accept me for who I am and stop trying to turn me into your comfortably numb dream-girl thing.
scene mayaboxwaitwhat14
: Fucking Maya...of course she’d hide that from me. There’d be no holding me back at all if I ever found out.
: Sounds like you and I would have been reacquainted much sooner if you did. So I guess I’ll go ahead and be mad at her too.
scene mayaboxwaitwhat15
: Can I...ask you something?
: I already told you. I don’t know what’s in the box.
: Not that. Just...did giving up on me ever cross your mind this past year? Did you not lose hope in me at any point?
: Of course not. Losing hope would imply that I ever had any hope in you to begin with. And that’s just dumb.
: Seriously, though...did you ever think about just...trying to find someone else?
: Romantically? No. I want you, so I am going to have you because I am cute and that entitles me to getting whatever it is I want.
scene mayaboxwaitwhat16
: I did have a sex dream about Otoha once, though. So you can go ahead and call that some sort of forbidden desire if that turns you on or something.
: It’s fine. I, too, have had sex dreams about Otoha.
scene mayaboxwaitwhat17
: You bastard. I am right here. Have you no consideration whatsoever for my feelings?
: I can’t tell if you’re being serious or not.
scene mayaboxwaitwhat18
: There’s a little bit of truth in every single lie, you know?  I won’t let myself get beat up over it, though.
scene mayaboxwaitwhat19
: I know I’ve got my work cut out for me if I’m going to find myself on the same level as all of the girls you’re currently sleeping with who haven’t disappeared at some point.
: But I’ll get there. I’ll get there and you’ll see why you chose me as “the one” long before you even met any of those girls.
: Then things will be good again. And we can go back to normal. Or change what’s normal if that’s really what you want.
: It’s like falling in love all over. I should feel lucky I get to experience that again.
scene mayaboxwaitwhat20
: But instead, I’m just sad.
: I miss you, Sensei.
: Maya-
scene mayaboxwaitwhat21
: Come on! Let’s get that box to school for whatever reason we’re supposed to take it there!
scene black
: Hah...yeah.
: I’m right behind you.
scene mayaboxwaitwhat22
: Wow. This place is actually kind of creepy at night.
: You should see it when it’s all red and crawling with weird, paranormal entities.
: Do I have to? That sounds like it sucks.
: I wouldn’t say you have to. Just know that if you do, it’s actually a good thing because it means you can start learning more about how the world works.
: Or...doesn’t work. It’s complicated.
: More...time stuff...right? Things that your me was interested in?
scene mayaboxwaitwhat23
: I’m not really sure how much of it was interest and...how much was just a result of her being forced to endure it for so long.
: Well, for what it’s worth, I am interested in that stuff. Sci-fi. Quantum physics. But it’s all more fiction-focused than anything involving actual science.
: But I blame you for that. You and Billy Pilgrim.
scene mayaboxwaitwhat24
: Me?
: Mhm. You and the high school curriculum you forced onto a child because you were so starved for an actual intellectual conversation after your sex-mom died.
scene mayaboxwaitwhat25
: Well, that sentence hit me like a truck.
: There’s another joke to be made here, but I think that one might be pushing it a bit.
: I’d appreciate it if you wouldn’t call her a “sex-mom” in the future. She was...a lot more than that, Maya.
: Right. Just like how you are more to me than what you tell yourself you are.
: So please don’t die, for I have seen what I would turn into and it is not pretty. If nothing else, try living for that.
scene mayaboxwaitwhat26
: I’m gonna go stash this in the room beside you. I’m pretty sure...that was the one we always put them in.
: Okay...I’ll be here.
scene black
I slide open the door to an empty classroom and drop the box off in the corner, trying (and failing) once more to open it.
I want to stay here.
Not just so I don’t have to go back out into the hall and face the fact that even this version of her — who smiles and speaks to me — is one I want to enrapture...
But to figure out what this is. And how Ami is somehow involved now.
Why would she ask Maya to take this here? Why can’t Maya open it either?
Was that...always how it worked?
Was that just something else she hid from me?
If I stay here, maybe I can see what happens.
Maybe I can see who comes to take this to wherever it’s meant to be- because it most assuredly isn’t the first. And it most assuredly won’t be the last.
If I never leave, though...
I’ll never see that smile again.
scene mayaboxwaitwhat27
And I’ll also never figure out what’s inside of the apparent sex closet — which is now, unfortunately, a top priority for me.
Right after I figure out why Maya dragged me back into my old classroom.
: Been a while, hasn’t it?
: And for good reason. I was never fit to be a high school teacher.
: You sure weren’t, Sensei. And anyone who’d pay you to hang out with teenage girls clearly isn’t fit to serve this community either.
: That was the part where most other people try to say something uplifting about how my methods are “unusual” but how I’ve wound up helping in the long run.
: Then I guess I don’t need to say anything because I’m living proof of that.
: Everything I am is because of you. And you have the rare opportunity right now to continue cultivating me. To make me something even bigger.
scene mayaboxwaitwhat28
: So come — over here. To my desk.
scene mayaboxwaitwhat29
: Teach me more about who I’ll be next. About what you want the result of the “Maya Raising Project” to be.
: I want you to be whatever makes you happy.
: Hahah. Cute. But really — what do you really want?
: An actor? Want me to perfectly mimic your last true love? Recite her lines like they’re my own? Even if they are my own. Which they are. Because again, same person.
: Or maybe someone even smarter than you? Someone like her. The first girl you lost.
: Just, whatever you do, don’t ask me to be an idol because I fucking hate Niki and I fucking hate her annoying bitch of a sister.
: I don’t know. I kind of want to see idol Maya now. Is there something like that in the sex closet?
scene mayaboxwaitwhat30
: There sure is. It just brings back bad memories.
: Was I too rough on you while you were wearing it?
: Worse. You started crying.
: Oh.
: Well, I’ve gotten more used to banging idols since then, so maybe that won’t happen anymore?
scene mayaboxwaitwhat31
: Again. I am right here. And still very much upset over the fact that your childhood friend is now sleeping in the same bed as you, thank you very much.
: So is it her you hate more? Or Noriko?
scene mayaboxwaitwhat32
: How is that relevant?! Aren’t you supposed to be teaching me about “old” Maya?!
: Old Maya hated both of them too and it was always sort of a touchy subject.
: It’s a touchy subject now too! So why do I have to be the one to do it?!
: Because I can no longer be gaslit into thinking that information may cause both the universe and me to explode.
scene mayaboxwaitwhat33
: Fine. You caught me. It is I — Maya prime. I never disappeared at all. I just faked it for attention. Guess we have to have sex now. Oh well.
: Wake me up when it’s over. I’ll be thinking about time and stuff.
: Close, but you’re not there yet.
: Fuck.
: You really won’t talk about it?
scene mayaboxwaitwhat34
: Sensei — I’m bad at talking. I don’t know how else to get that through to you. Like, fuck- all this banter alone is enough to make my head hurt.
: Then why-
: I said it earlier. Because I miss you.
scene mayaboxwaitwhat35
: When I sit down and try to remember literally anything about any part of my life — you’re there. You have always been there.
: So going this long without you and having to learn how to function as an actual independent person has been fucking bullshit.

: Which I’m sure you’ll give me shit about since you always talked about how important that was during tutoring, but whatever. I’ve never really wanted to be my own thing since meeting you in the first place.
: So yeah, I’ll talk to you. I’ll talk your ear off because I’m just excited to be near you again. I’m excited you’ll listen.
scene mayaboxwaitwhat36
: But that doesn’t mean it’s easy...even if it sounds like it is. Even if it looks like it is. Because things aren’t always exactly as they seem.
: You should know that much...right?
: Yeah...I know that much.
: So can we...maybe wait on the whole Nakayama discussion? Until after I’ve gotten less sour about how she’s your number one now and I’m just...there.
: I never said she was my number one, Maya.
scene mayaboxwaitwhat37
: She fucking sleeps in your bed, Sensei...
: She’s the first person to see you every single day. I’m lucky if I even do.
: Then I’ll see you more. Starting right now.
scene mayaboxwaitwhat38
: You...
: You will?
: I will.
: You’re not...just saying that to shut me up?
: No...I’m not.
: I’m ready to start...moving on. Or trying to. I can’t stay hung up on the memories of you when...
: When...what?
: When there’s a chance they might come back. That they’re...still in there somewhere. Like mine were.
: Just...mine were of...this same timeline. And yours would be of...probably millions.
: That’s not the answer you wanted to hear, is it?
: I’d have liked something more normal there, I think. Now I just have to worry about what would happen to me if I suddenly had millions of years worth of memories.
: Memories without you. Memories of looking for you. When I just told you minutes ago that you’re there for all of mine.
: You want me to lose that?...
: I...well...
: Can you just tell me you love me instead?
scene mayaboxwaitwhat39
: Or...something close at least.
: Natsume Sōseki.
scene mayaboxwaitwhat40
: ...I’m sorry?
: You know that one line, right? The one people are always using to say a thing without saying a thing.
: I do...
: You’re not...going to say that thing, though?
: Nope. Everybody says that thing now. So I’m just going to say the author’s name and you’re going to have to deal with it.
scene mayaboxwaitwhat41
: Heh...
: I’ll take it...
: I hope you know I’m...gonna hold you to that whole “seeing me more” thing too. Like...don’t be surprised if I’m just...there when you wake up one day.
: Next to Niki?
scene mayaboxwaitwhat42
: Yeah. I can show her how it’s done. Then she’ll feel so bad about her own abilities that she’ll be forced to move out and I can move in instead.
: Yeah. I’m sure Ami would love that.
: Fuck Ami.
: I’m sure Ami would love that too.
scene mayaboxwaitwhat43
: Heheh...probably too much.
We stand there...just staring at each other for a while. Wanting more, but taking nothing.
It feels kind of strange — the way we’re watched by the moon. And how it dissuades me from grabbing her wrist and pulling her back to my home right now.
I think...
I think there’s somewhere else I want to take her instead, though.
: Maya.
: Sensei.
: Are you hungry?
scene black
: Always.
